entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the ProFit cycling shoes, delivered on November 25th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's more of a fit issue. I've been on a few rides with them, and they're just not working for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels.
I'm sorry to hear that, getting blisters is definitely no fun and can ruin a ride. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, Alex, I've pulled up the policy. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, that's great. I wasn't sure what the policy was. So, a full refund is possible?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within 90 days, we can process a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the cycling shoes. I've just sent a return shipping label to the email address on file.

That's fantastic, thank you Isaac. I appreciate how easy that was. Since I do need to order a different pair, and given the trouble with the blisters, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I understand why you're asking, Alex. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for situations like this. However, I have processed the return for a complete refund, so you'll get the full amount back to find a pair that's a perfect fit.
Okay, that's fair enough. The straightforward refund is what matters most. Thanks again for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit. Goodbye.
